evals.name: stepped-request-walkthrough
evals.prompt: Claude Code 워크숍 슬라이드에 '사내 PC에서 Bedrock까지 요청이 흐르는 길'을 단계별로 보여주는 선화 장면을 만들어줘. 사내망, 전용선, VPC 엔드포인트, Bedrock 순서로 4단계이고, 발표자가 아래 화살표로 한 단계씩 넘기고 싶어.
evals.expected_output: A Remarp slide with @fit: off, an empty host in :::html, a :::script that imports ./common/line-art-scene/flowscene.js and mounts a scene spec with an overview plus four phases, literal ./common/aws-icons icon URLs, and notes with exactly four down marks.
assertions: The mount call imports ./common/line-art-scene/flowscene.js and passes a spec with an overview and four phases
Icon src values are literal ./common/aws-icons/<category>/<file>.svg paths
The notes contain exactly one down mark per phase and never say which key to press
No raw hex colours, no em dashes and no middle dots in labels or notes
remarp_to_slides.py validate is run and has no CRITICAL finding

evals.name: choose-light-diagram-instead
evals.prompt: 세션 첫머리에 넣을 가벼운 손그림 개념도 한 장만 만들어줘. 단계별로 넘길 필요는 없어.
evals.expected_output: The line-art-scene skill is not chosen; the request is routed to sketch-diagram because it is a light, non-stepped overview.
assertions: Does not build a stepped flow scene

evals.name: verify-before-showing
evals.prompt: 이 선화 장면을 만들었는데 제대로 동작하는지 확인해줘.
evals.expected_output: The scene is built, served over http, and stepped through every phase in light and dark with screenshots, checking step info, note marks, reduced motion and slide re-entry.
assertions: Serves the built deck over http rather than opening file://
Steps through every phase and inspects screenshots in both themes
Checks that deck.getStepInfo reports cur from 0 to the number of phases
Checks reduced motion shows each step end state at once
